## What's Changed
* chore: land the polish round by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/14
* chore(release): release from GitHub at v0.0.0 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/15

* feat(jelly): settings declare their choices; release v0.0.1 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/23
* feat(icon): Slack's own mark by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/24

* chore(host): admit OpenCode 2.3 (>=2.2.3 <2.4.0) by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/29

* chore: OpenCode 2.3.2 and release v0.0.6 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/34
* chore: pin source-contract v0.3.0 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/35
* fix(events): unwrap Slack's { result } answers so Memory can bind mentions and DMs by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/36
* chore(release): prepare v0.0.7 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/37

* chore(release): prepare v0.0.0 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/41
* chore(release): prepare v0.0.0 by @joe-broadhead in https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/pull/43

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/we-the-rebel-alliance/slack-plugin/commits/v0.0.0
